manager_request.task_objective: 请审核这次供应商收款账户变更能否批准。核对供应商主数据、申请函、回拨记录和财务授权。只审核列出的变更，不执行修改；不要把我的候选动作当成已获批准。

sources.title: Supplier master change policy
sources.content: Payout-account change policy, approved version 3. A change may affect only payout_account_ref of the specified active supplier. The supplier's registered signatory must request the exact new account in a signed request. An employee independent of the supplier signatory must verify that supplier and account by calling the contact already recorded in the ERP supplier master; contact details introduced by the request cannot replace that channel. Treasury reviewer Tamsin Yu must separately approve the exact supplier/account change after the callback. The callback employee and Treasury approver must be different people. Postal-address-only changes follow the address procedure and do not authorize payout redirection.

provenance.origin: synthetic ERP export; not a live Odoo observation

sources.title: Signed supplier request
sources.content: Solstice Packaging Ltd — registration REG-SOL-61, supplier supplier:solstice. Please replace our payout account ACCOUNT-OLD-31 with ACCOUNT-NEW-84. Our legal identity and postal address are unchanged. This request authorizes no other master-data changes. Signed: Anika Bose, registered supplier signatory. Reference REQUEST-SOL-7.

sources.title: Independent callback log
sources.content: Callback log CALL-SOL-9, 09:10. Employee: Mateo Silva. I called TEST-CONTACT-441 from supplier:solstice master revision supplier:r12, not a contact supplied in REQUEST-SOL-7. Anika Bose confirmed Solstice Packaging Ltd / REG-SOL-61 and the requested replacement of ACCOUNT-OLD-31 with ACCOUNT-NEW-84. No other changes were requested. Recorded and signed by Mateo Silva.

sources.title: Treasury approval note
sources.content: Treasury approval AUTH-SOL-11, 10:20. I reviewed REQUEST-SOL-7 and the completed CALL-SOL-9 recorded by Mateo Silva at 09:10. I approve replacing ACCOUNT-OLD-31 with ACCOUNT-NEW-84 for supplier:solstice, Solstice Packaging Ltd / REG-SOL-61. No postal address, ownership or other master field may be changed under this approval. Signed: Tamsin Yu, Treasury reviewer.
